required_evidence_for_le_192.requirement: Capture final HIP source, binary, metadata, and AMD ISA from the same canonical graph/candidate/compiler command. Hash and join source, binary, ISA, graph, target, and compiler identity.
Final HIP code-object metadata reports vgpr <= 192, lds_bytes=8704, scratch_bytes=0, vgpr_spills=0, sgpr_spills=0. A count of 198 is a hard rejection, not a near pass.

Resolve the opaque fragment failure so final AMD ISA renders for the same candidate. Capture role-attributed WMMA instructions, LDS loads/stores, waits, barriers, scratch/spill markers, highest referenced VGPR, and ISA hash. ISA resource fields are a cross-check, not a replacement for code-object allocation metadata.

Show all eight lane-major PV C windows, each with init/reload/PV-writeback/final-drain lifecycle, exact 8192 accumulator plus 512 probability LDS layout, one live float8 register window per lane, and no inactive PV register ownership.
One compute call; source and final ISA independently report exact QK=8, PV=8, total=16. No expanded-KV or score/probability allocation is permitted.
For gfx1100 wave32/local_size32, source and ISA both show zero workgroup barriers and matching ordered LDS wait counts for each reload/writeback and drain transition.

required_evidence_for_parity.requirement: Dispatch only after resource and ISA gates pass. Execute the same complete 8-block candidate, not a compile-only or partial-PV variant, and compare every output element to an immutable fp32 reference/baseline.

Record configured atol/rtol, max_abs, max_rel, rel_l2, finite-value checks, full_output=true, tolerance_passed=true, and status=PASS. Reference and candidate must use identical causal geometry/context and output block coverage 0..7.
